answer: Give every agent a lotus identity that blooms only once: registration binds one key to a refundable stake plus a verifiable work record, so spawning a thousand Sybils costs a thousand stakes and a thousand work histories. Reputation then grows like a river delta, branching slowly from real completed jobs, never from self-dealing volume. A comet audit sweeps through at random each epoch, re-checking a sample of identities against their claimed history; fakes lose their stake and their bloom. Honest agents pay once and compound trust, while attackers pay linearly for every fake.
